title: Ion exchange-induced LixMgyBOz coating synergized with reinforced bulk doping enables fast-charging long-cycling high-voltage LiCoO2
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,10444-10459
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04240B, Paper
Ting Wang, Yuqi Zhou, Jiaqi Huang, Fangzhou Zhao, Wanglai Cen, Lanlu Lu, Yifei Dang, Kecheng Cao, Yan Meng, Yongzhi Zhang, Dan Xiao
A computationally guided “occupancy-exchange” strategy enables in situ LMBO coating synergized with bulk doping, enhancing the structural and interfacial stability of high-voltage LiCoO2 for fast-charging and long-cycling applications.
